title: Jaafar Jackson: ‘Michael’ Sequel Will Give ‘More Insight’ Into Child Abuse Allegations and ‘Let His Voice Be Heard’
content:
ByIsabelle Farina

Now that the second “Michael” movie iscloser to starting production, starJaafar Jacksonsays it will indeed address the criticisms and child abuse allegations Michael Jackson faced in the ’90s.

Michael Jackson’s nephew Jaafar Jackson says that while he doesn’t have much say in how the screenplay is written, he tellsGQ Middle Eastthat he hopes the sequel will give more insight into Michael’s perspective.

“It’s someone else’s story,” Jaafar Jackson said. “It’s someone else’s idea of what it is, and it’s mainly driven by an agenda. And that’s really the issue we’ve been having as a family – not having Michael’s voice being heard. I think that’s very, very important, especially in the late years.”

The biopic rocked the box office this summer,surpassing $1 billionin global ticket sales. But the film only chronicles the first half of the icon’s career. It ends with the 1987 release of “Bad,” before the singer received his first allegation in 1993. Jaafar Jackson says the two-part feature provides an opportunity for a deeper understanding of Michael and his circumstances.

“This first film focuses on Michael from his roots,” Jackson said. “So you get that idea of who he was before he had all the success and became the icon that people are familiar with, you understand who he was as a human being first, because at the end of the day, that’s who he was in the ’90s until he passed. He never changed that purity, that sense of always wanting to find the good in other people. And no matter all the stuff he went through, how he was treated, what things were said about him, he never stopped treating people with kindness. He never stopped believing in and wanting to look for the good in people… even though he was broken, his heart still stayed the same… I hope that this is felt in the second movie.”
title_zh: 賈法·傑克森(Jaafar Jackson)：電影《麥可(Michael)》的續集將提供對兒童虐待指控的「更多洞察」，並「讓他的聲音被聽見」。
content_zh:
作者：伊莎貝爾·法里納(Isabelle Farina)

隨著第二部《邁克爾(Michael)》電影即將開始製作，主演賈法·傑克森(Jaafar Jackson)表示，這部電影確實會針對邁克爾·傑克森(Michael Jackson)在90年代所面臨的批評和兒童虐待指控進行探討。

邁克爾·傑克森的侄子賈法·傑克森表示，雖然他對劇本的撰寫沒有太多發言權，但他告訴《GQ中東版》(GQ Middle East)希望續集能夠更深入地了解邁克爾的觀點。

“這是別人的故事，”賈法·傑克森說。“這是別人對這個故事的想法，主要是由某種議程驅動的。這正是我們作為一個家庭所面臨的問題——邁克爾的聲音未被聽見。我認為這是非常非常重要的，尤其是在他生命的晚期。”

這部傳記片在今年夏天的票房表現驚人，全球票房超過10億美元。但該片僅記錄了這位偶像職業生涯的前半段，結尾是1987年《壞(Bad)》的發行，之後他在1993年首次遭到指控。賈法·傑克森表示，這部兩部分的電影提供了更深入理解邁克爾及其處境的機會。

“這部電影的第一部分聚焦於邁克爾的根源，”傑克森說。“所以你可以了解到他在獲得成功並成為人們熟悉的偶像之前是誰，你首先理解他作為一個人是誰，因為最終，他在90年代直到去世都是這樣的人。他從未改變那份純真，始終想要在其他人身上尋找美好。無論他經歷了什麼，受到怎樣的對待，對他說了什麼，他從未停止以善良對待他人。他從未停止相信並想要尋找人們的美好……即使他受傷，他的心依然保持不變……我希望這一點能在第二部電影中被感受到。”
